svg.aria-label: Freshness ladder, all Tip. Minutes to hours: wet scat, warm bed, green browse ends, crisp tracks, dew knocked off grass. Today: track edges sharp, scat dull but soft, scrape dark and damp. This week: dry scat, grey browse ends, softened tracks, bed with refrozen snow. Old: faded, crumbling, moss, leaves in the track. Hunt within 300 m of the freshest sign at dawn or dusk.

g.text: wet scat, warm bed, green twig ends, dew off
sharp track edges, soft scat, damp scrape
dry scat, grey twig ends, refrozen bed
faded, crumbling, moss, leaves in the track

svg.text: Hunt within 300 m of the freshest (Tip)
